data.narrative:
Mara is a Pre-Seed stage defense and security company that has raised $1.6M to date. The relevant comp universe includes 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers in Defense & Security, with top-tier private comparables including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two quantitative valuation methods were evaluated. Stage-Progression methodology was deemed inapplicable because the implied valuation of $750M (applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier to a $300M base derived from total raised) substantially exceeds 20x the company's actual capital raised, indicating the base value proxy is unreliable. Peer-Median analysis was also skipped due to insufficient comparable data—while 26 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filter criteria (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier) yielded fewer than 3 datapoints, and using a broad sector median would lack sufficient specificity to pre-seed stage companies.

Given the lack of applicable quantitative triangulation, valuation cannot be reliably established from the available data. Material uncertainties include the absence of revenue or financial metrics, lack of sufficiently granular peer comparables at pre-seed stage in this sector, and limited information on product development status or customer traction. A credible valuation would require either expansion of the comparable set to adjacent stages or procurement of revenue / product milestone data specific to Mara.
